title: Signing in with a passkey
checked: Every reachable state checked (11 states, 41 with their data, 47 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 11 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: No sign-in without a fresh signature
rules.says: Keycloak signs you in only with a signature for the challenge it just sent.
rules.path: Take away the signature fits guard and it breaks in 10 steps: sign in, begin, challenge, ask the phone, Face ID, signature, replay an old one, find the key, public key, verify.

rules.rule: The phone signs only for its owner
rules.says: The passkey signs nothing until Face ID knows the face.
rules.path: Take away the face matches guard and it breaks in 5 steps: sign in, begin, challenge, ask the phone, a stranger looks.
